test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**especially**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Option 3, "especially**," is the correct answer.
 
• The sentence is stating that **high adoption rates of online booking tools** are **feasible**, **particularly when a full implementation approach** is used.
 
• "**Especially**" is used to **emphasize that a particular factor or condition is important in a given situation**, which is the case here.

Thus, ***option 3*** is the correct answer.

Correct paragraph__: *When suited to each company's individual environment, online booking solutions provide (1) proven benefits. To get the full benefits of online booking, businesses must develop a customised (2) strategy and apply it thoroughly. Companies that want to cut costs while providing simple booking options for tourists are increasingly using online booking tools (OBTs). Many factors impact online acceptance, ranging from the macroeconomic background to company culture, yet high adoption rates are feasible, (3) especially when a full implementation approach is used. Companies must also carefully (4) weigh the benefits and drawbacks of adopting a single OBT or best-in-market OBTs regionally or locally, as well as whether to source directly or through reseller arrangements. Corporatee online booking systems, when used correctly, enable businesses to achieve considerable savings while providing passengers with simple (5) service features.*
